677:t_042:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Most likely the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ gave the Queen an unreasonable order, and her power has gone out of control!」

677:t_042:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A $$時空震動$$ that engulfs everything around it...! Its scale is unimaginable!」

677:t_042:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, fall back! Keep as far from the Queen as you can!」

677:t_042:8.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$アルト$$! You fall back too!」

677:t_042:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「Humans used the $$バジュラ$$ as their tools... If we part from the Queen like this, the $$バジュラ$$ will surely go on misunderstanding humans.」

677:t_042:13.en:
$$アルト$$
「So I'll... stay with this one.」

677:t_042:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「I guess that's the part I was given to play.」

677:t_042:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「Idiot! You're going to leave the woman you love behind?!」

677:t_042:17.en:
$$アルト$$
「...Everyone, get out of here fast. If we're lucky, we'll meet again.」

677:t_042:19.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You idiot! You're overdoing the hero act!」

677:t_042:20.en:
$n
「Isn't there anything you can do, Dr. $$トライア$$!?」

677:t_042:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The Fold Wave System installed in $$アルト$$'s unit... With the help of its power, perhaps...」

677:t_042:25.en:
$$アルト$$
「Believe me, $$バジュラ$$... We're not your enemy.」

677:t_043:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The $$バジュラ$$ Queen has transferred! Also, Ensign $$アルト$$ and all of $c's ships and units are safe!」

677:t_043:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「I don't know why, but here I am too...」

677:t_043:6.en:
$$レド$$
「Did the $$バジュラ$$ come to understand humanity?」

677:t_043:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah... I didn't sense any hostility from the Queen.」

677:t_043:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「I wonder what will happen to the $$バジュラ$$ from here on...」

677:t_043:9.en:
$$桂$$
「Isn't it obvious? They've found their partners.」

677:t_043:10.en:
$$刹那$$
「Swarms of $$バジュラ$$ that understand humans will meet each other, and new $$バジュラ$$ will be born...」

677:t_043:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Surely that will change their very way of being.」

677:t_043:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「But to make that happen, we have to protect this universe.」

677:t_043:13.en:
$$ラム$$
「Communication with the residents of Island 1 has been restored. $$大統領$$ $$ハワード・グラス$$ also appears to be safe.」

677:t_043:15.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We can probably leave the protection of the citizens to the government of the $$フロンティア船団$$.」

677:t_043:16.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain! The $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ is coming to this planet!」

677:t_044:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They made it here too.」

677:t_044:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「According to a message from the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, everyone in $c and the Galactic Raid Fleet are somehow safe!」

677:t_044:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「It seems the new $$バスターマシン$$ No. 3 has also been confirmed intact.」

677:t_044:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Now that the ambitions of the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ are crushed, we'll advance in one push to the galactic center point.」

677:t_044:8.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$バアル$$... The time for the decisive battle with the $$宇宙怪獣$$ is coming...」

677:t_045:2.en:
$$アルト$$
(I'm never going anywhere alone again. The place where I rest my wings is next to you.)

677:t_045:3.en:
$$アルト$$
(And I'll keep on flying... $$ランカ$$... to protect you.)

677:t_046:2.en:
$$アルト$$
(I'm never going anywhere alone again. The place where I rest my wings is next to you.)

677:t_046:3.en:
$$アルト$$
(And I'll keep on flying... $$シェリル$$... to protect you.)

677:t_047:0.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I am the Human Support Enlightenment Regulation System. In other words, the being called god.」

677:t_047:1.en:
$$ストライカー#pilot$$
「I am the Human Support Enlightenment Regulation System. In other words, a being... called... god...」

677:t_048:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Destruction of $$ストライカー・Ｘ３７５２#pilot$$ confirmed.」

677:t_049:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「All Slaves have also self-destructed. It appears a system was built in that self-destructs upon the loss of the Master.」

677:t_050:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「This doesn't feel like an atmosphere for basking in the joy of victory.」

677:t_050:2.en:
$$レド$$
「I can't explain it well, but it seems to me that its existence was the $$人類銀河同盟$$ itself...」

677:t_050:3.en:
$$レド$$
「A system that refuses to recognize humans as human... That Striker was trying to build it anew...」

677:t_050:4.en:
$n
「But people can change. Just like you, who used to be one of them.」

677:t_050:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「Changing little by little is what makes humans strong. You understand that too, don't you?」

677:t_050:8.en:
$$レド$$
($$エイミー$$... Someday I want to take you to the $$人類銀河同盟$$.)

677:t_050:9.en:
$$レド$$
(And I want everyone in the Alliance to know. How wonderful it is to live as a human.)

677:t_050:10.en:
$$レド$$
(Maybe that is my new battle, as the one who defeated Striker...)

677:t_050:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit wishes to take part in that battle as well.」

677:t_050:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit grasps your thinking, Ensign. This is because...」

677:t_050:14.en:
$$レド$$
「We're partners, after all. ...I'm counting on you from now on too, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

677:t_050:15.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. Supporting Ensign $$レド$$ is this unit's very reason for existence.」

677:t_051:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...With this, my battle will end too...」

677:t_051:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I am tired... Now... let me sleep...」
